# Clock fonts

`app/src/main/res/font/clock_*.ttf` are derived from fonts of the Google Fonts collection
(https://github.com/google/fonts), each licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; each
font's license is in the folder of the same name here.

Changes from the originals, made with fontTools: variable fonts instanced at one bold weight
(700, or 800 for Montserrat, Nunito, Manrope, Plus Jakarta Sans, Figtree and Urbanist; 600 for
Teko), subset to Latin characters, and renamed with a "TK " prefix. Fonts whose license reserves
their name (Raleway, Russo One) were left out rather than renamed.
